comment: Claude Managed Agents roster rules this repository does not enforce yet.
Each entry is one documented CMA validation that a managed agent create/update
currently accepts. The list is a ratchet: it may only shrink. Enforcing a rule
means deleting its entry; the conformance test fails while an enforced rule is
still listed, so the two cannot drift apart.
Source: platform.claude.com Managed Agents multiagent orchestration reference.
